questions.code:
for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) cnt++;
questions.e: Nested loops multiply: n rounds × n rounds = n².

questions.code: for (int i = 1; i < n; i *= 2) cnt++;
questions.e: i doubles each round, so it reaches n after about log₂ n rounds.
Keep the fastest-growing term and drop the constant in front of it.

questions.code: for (int i = 1; i * i <= n; i++) cnt++;
questions.e: The loop stops once i × i passes n, which is after about √n rounds.

questions.q: n ≤ 2 × 10^5 with a 1-second limit. Which complexity is safe?
questions.e: O(n log n) is about 3.5 × 10^6 steps. O(n²) would be about 4 × 10^10, far above the roughly 10^8 operations per second.
j is set once and never reset, so the while loop moves j from 0 to n only once in total. The total work is about 2n.

questions.q: What is the extra space of vector<int> a(n) plus a few variables?
questions.e: The vector stores n numbers. A few single variables are O(1), so the total is O(n).

questions.code:
for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
    for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) cnt++;
questions.e: The inner loop depends on i: 1 + 2 + … + n = n(n + 1)/2, which is O(n²).
